notes: The ROS builder fills the window. In Review (no row buttons) or on a screen wider than its columns, Notes stretches to fill the space instead of leaving an empty strip. Make the inspector taller or shorter: drag its top edge (or put the focus on it and use ↑ ↓). The height is kept on this Mac; double-click the edge to fit it to its tab again. After a sixth critique (29/40): each row's ↑ ↓ + ✕ show only on the row under the mouse, the picked rows and the row being edited (✕ set apart from +).
